briefing.headline: TOP rockets 25.3% as small‑cap surge leads overnight rally
briefing.summary: Mega‑cap tech names mostly slipped, pulling the core index average down by about 0.6%. The broader market breadth was thin, with only two advancers among the core group. Meanwhile a handful of small‑cap and niche stocks surged, led by TOP (+25.3%) and AMBQ (+21.4%). The mixed picture suggests sector‑specific moves rather than a unified market direction.
